spoken_script: Nvidia reportedly in talks to acquire Hugging Face. Reports from The Information and Business Insider indicate Nvidia is in advanced discussions to acquire the open-source AI platform Hugging Face for approximately $13 billion. Why it matters: Hugging Face serves as a central hub for the open-source AI developer ecosystem; an acquisition would represent a major consolidation of AI infrastructure and community-driven model development under Nvidia.
